messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a broken anchor in the onboarding runbook pointing to "#kv-cache" that 404s in staging. small PR would fix it.
aj: which file/anchor? paste the exact link please
maria: docs/onboarding.md -> the header was renamed to "kv cache internals" but the anchor stayed #kv-cache in a lot of links. example: /handbook/onboarding#kv-cache -> 404.
sam: I can pick this up tomorrow morning (8:30–10:30 PT). if it's tiny I can do it now.
maria: it's literally a one-line anchor rename. suggested patch: update the internal link to `#kv-cache-internals` or re-add the legacy anchor in the doc. I made a quick branch: `docs/patch/runbook-anchor-fix`.
aj: could we add a brief redirect anchor comment so old links still work? safer than changing many callers.
sam: adding a legacy HTML anchor sounds good — easiest and backwards compatible.
maria: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2487 — title: "runbook: add legacy anchor for kv cache link". CI ran: docs-lint green, static build passed. docs-bot: PR created by maria (CI: docs-lint OK)
docs-bot: New PR opened: #2487 by maria — runbook anchor fix.
aj: quick code review now: left one tiny nit in the PR about TOC slug consistency.
maria: pushed a fixup commit addressing the TOC entry and added a one-line comment explaining why the legacy anchor exists (so future editors don't remove it).
sam: @aj can you approve? I tested the link locally with `yarn docs:build` and the fragment resolves.
aj: reviewed & approved. merging once CI finishes. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks! I'm out after 2pm PT today so much appreciated. filing a follow-up issue to sweep other runbook links that still point to the old header.
sam: merged and deployed (merged by sam). :shipit:
aj: quick follow-up — there's an image nearby missing alt text; left a tiny issue on repo.
maria: noted and added to my backlog. thanks everyone. if you see anything similar please ping #docs or drop a trivial PR — saves the oncall chase. :pray:
